title: MOSS-Image film and camera look presets
author: Robert Gourley

usage.note: Say the look at the start and again at the end of the prompt. Negative prompt = MOSS usual negative + negative_extra.
usage.usual_negative: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
usage.tested_settings: ComfyUI MOSS template: er_sde, 25 steps, CFG 2.5, 1216x832, no LoRAs, no prompt rewriter

licence_note: Prompts copied from the blog author's published recipes for private homelab use; confirm reuse terms with the author before redistributing.
